9.MULTIPLE PREGNANCY:

Timing of division and consequences

•Two cell stage = DADC.
•Blastocytic stage = MCDA.
•Bilaminar Disc = MAMC.
•Twins in general 1:80 and IVF 1:4

1st USG:

•11 – 13 + 6weeks.
•G. Age by CRL – twins /triplets (larger baby’s CRL is used for determination of gestational age).
•No of Fetuses.
•No of placenta.
•Nuchal translucency.

Chorionicity:

•Best determined at 11 – 13 + 6 weeks.

1st :

1. No of placenta.

2. Lambda sign.

3. Membrane thickness < 1.8mm => MC.

Not detected

 

Refer to senior sonologist.

 

Yet not determined => consider monochorionic.

2nd :

1. No on placenta

2. Lambda sign

3. Membrane thickness

4. Sex of baby

3D USG:

Composite method 95% sensitivity.

•Placental mass + membrane thickness + membrane insertion.
⇨TAS is preferred
⇨High BMI – TVS.

 

Specialist care: by core and enhanced team

•Core Team: consist of
-Obstetric specialist.
-Midwife.
-USG specialist.

Core Team responsibilities: Information Giving:

-Antenatal and postnatal maternal health.
-Nutrition.
-Risk and symptoms of PTL and steroid use.
-Breast feeding
-MOD
-Parenting.
•Enhanced Team: consist of
-Perinatal mental health specialist
-Physiotherapist, nutritionist.
-Infant feeding specialist.

Antenatal visits in multiple pregnancies

DADC – 8 visits – 4 weekly USG=>booking, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36 (16 & 18 without USG).

- 2 with specialist and 6with core team

- Delivery @ 37 – 38 weeks.

DAMC – 9 visits – 2 weekly USG => Booking, 16, 18, 20. 22, 24, 28, 32, 34.

4 weekly

- 7 – core Team.

- 2 – specialist team.

- delivery @36 – 38 weeks.

 

MAMC – consultant, tertiary level of care at hospital.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

TCTA – 7 visits, 4 weekly USG => Booking, 20, 24, 28, 32.

- 2 weekly – 32 – 34.

- Without USG – 16 weeks.

 

MCTA/ DCTA – 11 visits, 2 weekly USG => booking, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, 30, 32, 34.

 

MCMA triplets = tertiary care with FMU.

- MCDA.

- DCDA.

 

DS Screening:

Twins triplets

- PAPPA - Age

- NT - NT

- βHCG

MC DC

Per pregnancy risk per baby risk.

 

Anatomical survey:

TTTS, IUGR.

Offer targeted steroid:

Twins 60% deliver before 37 weeks.

Triplets 75% deliver before 35 weeks.

Maternal complications of Multiple pregnancy:

•HTN: Aspirin 75mg after 12 weeks.
•If 1 or more of following:
-1st pregnancy.
-Age >40.
-BMI >35.
-Interval >10 years.
-History of Pre-eclampsia.
•5 times risk of HTN in primigravida.

10 times risk in multigravida.

•Hydramnios 12%.
•PTL >50%.
•NVP 3 times.
•Miscarriage risk is twice

Fetal complications of multiple pregnancy:

•Risk of Still birth 10times.
•Twin entrapment 1/817.
•SIUD = 2 – 6%.
